deviations.manifestText: Existing desktop ORION must run through ORION Core without meaningful behavioral regression.
deviations.actual: Nothing runs through Core. One read-only capability (system_status) is envelope-wrapped by a fail-open observer behind a default-off flag, while the legacy OpenClaw route still performs validation, execution, independent verification, and the ledger append.
deviations.why: The active product route is TypeScript/Swift. Routing live turns through the Python Core would add a process hop the runtime decision in planning/v2/PHASE_1_RUNTIME_DECISION.md explicitly rejected.
deviations.consequence: Phase 2 entry is being taken on the PHASE_1_PLAN.md reading of the gate, not the manifest's literal one. Whoever opens Phase 2 must either accept that reading in writing or widen the bridge until the literal gate is met.
